explanation: The film's 2019 Neo-Tokyo is building a stadium for the 2020 Games. In 2013 the International Olympic Committee chose Tokyo to host the 2020 Olympics, later held in 2021.

claims.text: In Akira (1988), the Neo-Tokyo of 2019 is preparing to host the 2020 Olympic Games, with a stadium under construction.
In 2013 the International Olympic Committee chose Tokyo to host the 2020 Summer Olympics.
Akira's Neo-Tokyo is not shown preparing for a World Expo, the Asian Games or a Formula One race.
The Tokyo 2020 Olympics were postponed and held in 2021.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Formula One's Japanese race is held outside Tokyo. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: a Japanese production; the Olympics are a worldwide event.
